risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (or the exact model shown on the machine’s screen/menu).

risks.risk: Not actually fully functional (paper feed, scanning, fuser/heat, or drum/toner issues).
risks.proof: A short video or photo sequence showing: power on → menu screen → copy a page → output page with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs service) until a test copy/print is shown.

risks.risk: Consumables/parts condition unknown (toner level, drum life, fuser life, maintenance errors).
risks.proof: Photo of the toner/drum/maintenance status screen (or inside access showing cartridge/toner type and condition).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming consumables may be low/near end-of-life (worst case: buyer may need replacements).

risks.risk: Connectivity/compatibility issues (USB/LAN not working, driver/network settings unknown).
risks.proof: Photo of ports + a test print from a phone/laptop (or a screenshot showing successful connection).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming basic local operation only; connectivity may require setup/repair.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in these angles (rollers, glass, hinges, scanner carriage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the scanner glass, platen, and paper path areas; plus a video of the scanner moving.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing minor repairs (worst case: treat as used with unknown internal condition).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (so AR-M201 is confirmed from the machine, not only from text).
A short video showing a full copy/print test: load paper → start copy → finished output page.
Photo/screenshot of the machine’s status/toner/drum/maintenance screen (showing no critical errors).
Photo of toner/drum access area (or inside view) and a close-up of the scanner glass/platen.
Photo of connectivity ports and a quick test print from a laptop/phone (or LAN/USB).
response.reason: The photos show a Sharp all-in-one copier/printer, but the exact AR-M201 model and “fully functional” claim are not verifiable from the provided images. A test copy/print and a clear model label shot are needed before pricing confidently.
